detail: a tabbed brass scale register binding separate world, regional, and local map leaves, each marked with its own measured extent, orientation, and shared place bearings

evidence.quote: A world atlas locates regional maps; each regional map locates local terrain; each local terrain anchors building floorplans.

facts.extent: a long brass index with one numbered tab for each surveyed map leaf
facts.scale_ref: rests beside the Living Atlas and can be read while turning between map scales
facts.material: engraved brass tabs, linen binding cord, and inked vellum slips
facts.state: bearings are cross-referenced; an unverified route is marked as a claim, not a connection

note: Each map scale is an independent canvas with an explicit transform to its parent map. MOSS Layouts are flat per image; do not model world-to-region hierarchy as nested MOSS bounding boxes. Stable coordinates, route topology, and confidence belong to map data.
